en-US.description: Upload an image to repair and a reference shoe/boot product image to adjust or repair footwear details worn by the model with one click.
en-US.error.noModels: No AI model is currently available
en-US.error.noSize: The current model does not provide a usable size preset
en-US.error.references: The uploaded images do not contain usable reference identifiers
en-US.label: Footwear Repair
en-US.maskPainter.help: Paint over the footwear area that needs focused repair. AI will prioritize the marked region. If you do not mark anything, AI will detect it automatically.
en-US.maskPainter.noSource: Upload the image to repair first
en-US.refMaskPainter.help: Paint over the footwear detail area to extract from the reference product image. AI will transfer the style of that region to the marked area in the image to repair.
en-US.refMaskPainter.noSource: Upload the reference product image first
en-US.upload.referenceProductImage.help: Upload a flat-lay, stand-alone, or model product image of the footwear as the repair reference.
en-US.upload.sourceImage.help: Upload the model image whose footwear needs repair. AI will preserve the person and scene while repairing the shoe or boot details.

zh-CN.description: 上传待修复图和参考商品图，一键调整、修复模特穿着鞋靴的细节。
zh-CN.empty.referenceProductImage: 请先上传 1 张参考商品图
zh-CN.empty.sourceImage: 请先上传 1 张待修复图
zh-CN.error.noModels: 暂无可用 AI 模型
zh-CN.error.noSize: 当前模型缺少可用尺寸配置
zh-CN.error.references: 图片缺少可用于生成的资源标识
zh-CN.label: 鞋靴修复
zh-CN.maskPainter.help: 在图上涂抹需要重点修复的鞋靴区域，AI 将优先处理标记部分。不标记时 AI 自动识别。
zh-CN.refMaskPainter.help: 在参考商品图上涂抹要提取的鞋靴细节区域，AI 将把该区域的风格迁移到待修复图的标记范围内。
zh-CN.upload.referenceProductImage.help: 支持上传单张平铺图、独立展示图或模特穿着图，作为鞋靴款式或细节修复参考。
zh-CN.upload.sourceImage.help: 上传需要修复鞋靴的模特图，AI 会在保留人物与场景的前提下修正鞋靴细节。
